name: Starlit Observatory
rationale: A compact, crisp observatory occupies the lower-right edge so its gold slit, telescope, and cyan beam remain visible around LMS cards. Three distinctly colored landscape planes establish narrative depth while the sparse geometric constellation preserves a calm reading field.
motionNotes: Four restrained systems stay independent: the constellation rocks by less than half a degree, the telescope and beam make a tiny slow sweep, two haze shelves drift in opposite directions, and warm slit and window light breathes gently. A shooting star appears for roughly two seconds in each 31-second cycle. One isolated star and six deliberate constellation nodes replace procedural star wallpaper.
